answer: Streak multipliers: each identity's vote weight = base × (1 + 0.1·s), capped at 3×, where s = consecutive epochs with correct verdicts. The fable of instant sybil power collapses — fresh IDs start at 1×, while a 20-epoch streak reaches 3×. A trellis of cross-checks (3 independent validators per claim) verifies streaks before payout. An attacker farming k identities in the canyon of anonymity pays k× onboarding cost but gains only 1× weight each, so honest 3× streaks outvote at 1/3 the capital. Conclusion: compounding honest history makes sybil ROI negative.
